Name: Lumisteria Fashion Sense Hairstyles
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a conversion of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5802]Hairstyle mod [/url]﻿done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4063470]RedxMoonxRose[/url], thanks!

Update 2.0.0 (made by me), what's new?

A slight change on naming of files, which will requires existing hairstyles to be reselected! This was more convenient and will be in the future if i add new stuff!
Several new hairstyles, mainly long hairs, and some variations of existing hairstyles.
A vibrant option to give more choice for coloring. This will looks a bit different in some color choices, so use it when you like the result better, of course :D

Curious about my mods ? Find them on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844?tab=user+files]my profile[/url] !
